name: Habane Kotori
source: A beautiful girl bound to a wheelchair. She is a slender girl with long, black hair and a tidy appearance but is strong-willed and speaks with confidence. Also, a crybaby. Because she transferred to Keifuu Academy for the simple reason that she is unable to move her legs and Keifuu Academy is completely barrier free, she has no interests in classes which teach specialty fields. Because of this, she is completely cut off from those around her.
